NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
for the year ended 3 December 2006

47 COUNTRY OF INCORPORATION
The company is incorporated and domiciled in Kenya under the Companies Act.
48 CURRENCY
The individual financial statements of each group entity are presented in the currency of the primary economic environment in which the
entity operates (its functional currency). For the purpose of the consolidated financial statements, the results and financial position of each
entity are presented in Kenya Shillings thousands (Sh’000), which is the functional currency of the group, and the presentation currency for
the consolidated financial statements.
65 NIC Bank Limited Annual Report 2006
